{{Infobox auto}}

A '''pumpkin empanada''' is the meal of the [[pumpkin]]. It heals {{Hp|8}} and grants {{EffectLink|Resistance}} for 8 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pumpkin_empanada.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Pumpkin|baked pumpkin]], sugar, estus ash and [[dough]]. Obtaining a baked pumpkin unlocks the recipe.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a pumpkin empanada takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|8}} and gives Resistance I for 8:00.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].

== Trivia ==
* The developer describes it as pumpkin baked "with sugar and spice".<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Preserve the pumpkin into pumpkin jam for more potent resistance, or bake it with sugar and spice to make a delicious empanada.}}</ref>
